insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Reshoevn8r UK grew total sales +47.4% WoW to $2,422 (prior $1,643) on 122 units, with organic sales more than doubling to $846 (+102.3%). The Shoe Cleaner Kit led at $574 (+87.5%) with CVR up +93.1% to 9.7%, the Waterproof Shoe Spray rose to $217 (+97.1%), and the 16oz Cleaning Solution grew to $404 (+70.5%) at a strong 24.1% CVR. Wednesday, Nov 18 was the peak day at $454.

**Metrics to Watch —** The Refresh Kit eased to $208 (-16.0%), primarily driven by sessions falling -19.4% to 129, while its CVR actually improved +7.5% to 10.1%, so shoppers who reach the page are buying. Overall growth held up well around it, with PPC revenue up +28.6% to $1,576 and organic sales up +102.3%. We are rebuilding traffic to the Refresh Kit to bring its volume back.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** ROAS improved to 1.67x from 1.44x and TACoS dropped to 38.9% from 51.89%, as ad spend of $941 (prior $853) generated $1,576 in PPC revenue (+28.6%). Ad conversion is healthy at 12.74%; ACOS at 59.7% and the 0.11% ad CTR are the levers we are working on next.

**Actions This Week —** (1) Push budget toward the 16oz Cleaning Solution (24.1% CVR) and the Shoe Cleaner Kit (9.7% CVR, +93.1%) to compound this week's gains. (2) Add targeted Sponsored Products coverage for the Refresh Kit to lift sessions back above 129. (3) Trim high-ACOS search terms and test fresh ad creative to bring ACOS below 59.7% and lift ad CTR above 0.11%.
